intent: Complete the original approved Evolution Expert scheme through Expert v1.0.1 completion recovery: deliver and independently prove real Codex, designated-human WorkBuddy, generic Agent, generic MCP, future Host, tutorial, project onboarding and adjustment, Runtime-owned resume, installation, verification, upgrade, rollback, and uninstall journeys with TRACE01-TRACE06, exact Candidate-pair binding, and NO_REGRESSION, without giving the Expert Runtime truth or Harness authority.
objective: Deliver an immutable Evolution Expert 1.0.1 completion successor whose Agent-neutral Core and generated adapters make every approved ordinary-human journey discoverable and operable across supported Hosts while every requirement is criterion-specifically validated and the product remains stateless, independently versioned, read-only toward Harness assets, and optional to complete headless Runtime operation.

include: Bind the same digest-addressed original-scheme inventory and cross-product traceability matrix as Runtime 5.0.1, mapping every Expert v1.0.0 requirement, explicit user correction, audited gap, current criterion, inherited criterion, validator, evidence contract, and terminal Expert journey.

Implement and package one Agent-neutral Expert Core plus generated Codex, WorkBuddy, generic Agent, and generic MCP adapters whose installed artifacts bind exact Core, protocol, capability, compatibility, and adapter digests and contain no Host-specific business, Lifecycle, Harness, authority, or recovery semantics.

Provide complete real installation lifecycle runbooks and executable verification for Codex and designated-human WorkBuddy: install, discover, help, tutorial, verify, upgrade, rollback, uninstall, clean reinstall, version, onboarding, adjustment, recovery explanation, Runtime-owned resume, and next-action guidance.

Make new-project registration and project-definition adjustment genuinely interactive through Runtime-provided typed questions, detected values, defaults, previews, semantic impacts, immutable active-run behavior, migration and rollback, without requesting raw secrets or inventing Runtime state.

Provide version-aware README and technical documentation, installed documentation routing, guided tutorials, concepts, architecture boundaries, Host Adapter authoring, MCP integration, troubleshooting, migration, and exact commands verified from packaged artifacts.

Implement criterion-specific independent validators and evidence collectors for every EXFUNC and EXCAP criterion, V4 inherited criterion, Expert v1.0.0 predecessor criterion, EXE2E01-EXE2E08, TRACE01-TRACE06, impact closure, cross-product compatibility, and NO_REGRESSION.

Prove an exact Expert 1.0.1 Candidate with the exact compatible Runtime 5.0.1 Candidate outside source checkout across real Codex, designated-human WorkBuddy, an independent Host, generic MCP, and headless Runtime, including restart, resume, upgrade, rollback, uninstall, absence, incompatibility, and zero-legacy-Suite-invocation variants.

Create a separately packaged and independently versioned @evopilot/evolution-expert workspace with its own changelog, tag namespace, Candidate, acceptance, release authorization, public artifact, upgrade, rollback, and uninstall paths.

Implement one Agent-neutral Expert Core for intent routing, progressive disclosure, schema-driven questions, deterministic rendering, installed-version help, tutorials, recovery guidance, and result explanation.
Generate Codex, WorkBuddy, generic Agent, and generic MCP adapters from the same Core semantics and bind every adapter to exact Core, protocol, capability, and compatibility digests.

Guide project discovery, new-project onboarding, project-definition adjustment and rollback, Harness match explanation, combined Harness plus Lifecycle plan explanation, Goal Target Loop progress, evidence inspection, recovery, acceptance readiness, and release readiness through Runtime-owned protocol objects.
Provide side-effect-free first-run tutorials, contextual documentation routing, examples, troubleshooting, and version-aware migration help.
Resume from durable Runtime-owned state after restart or Host transfer without creating Expert-owned canonical state.
Provide a third-party Host Adapter authoring and conformance kit requiring zero Engine source modification.
Prove real Codex and designated-human WorkBuddy ranges against exact Runtime and Expert Candidates plus an independent machine-operable Host path.
Preserve fully capable CLI, API, and CI Runtime operation when Expert or any one Host Adapter is absent or incompatible.

Before v5 public release, treat real EvoPilot and DataRig Codex Suites as active and independently evolving; use late-bound read-only snapshots and prove Expert independence only in isolated Candidate environments where both Suites are absent.
Keep actual Suite disablement, archival, uninstall, and retirement outside this Target and after verified v5 installation under a separate Cutover Target and separate human authorization.
exclude: Any claim that public Expert 1.0.0, Runtime 5.0.0, their aggregate acceptance records, or publication alone proves the original Expert or v5 scheme complete.

Any silent exclusion, bulk PASS projection, warning-as-pass, generic aggregate evidence, source-checkout substitution, or human declaration substituted for required machine evidence outside the exact designated-human WorkBuddy completion boundary.
Project, Lifecycle, Harness, Goal, Target, Loop, evidence, acceptance, recovery, publication, or Release truth ownership.
Harness selection, scoring, fabrication, authoring, mutation, approval, publication, Catalog mutation, or Registry mutation.
Approval identity, credentials, raw secrets, production or database authority, or durable canonical Runtime state.
Host-specific Lifecycle, Harness, authority, business, recovery, or release semantics in any generated adapter.
A general-purpose coding Agent, model loop, execution tool loop, or embedded Runtime.
Lockstep versioning or release dependency between Expert and EvoPilot Runtime.
Modifying evopilot-harness or treating its Digital Expert as this product.

Implementation, commit, push, Candidate build, acceptance, Codex or WorkBuddy operation, npm publication, GitHub Release, production access, or database access under this unapproved completion-recovery draft.
Any real EvoPilot or DataRig Codex Suite disablement, archival, uninstall, retirement, default switch, or mutation under this Target.
